annotations.title: Measure a site's headers and cache facts again now, after a fix

description: Wraps POST /api/sites/{slug}/insights/recheck. Measure a site's headers and cache facts again now, after a fix. Call this after deploying a header or cache fix, instead of waiting for the daily run: the monitor fetches each page the daily run reads once (no browser) within 30 seconds, and the headers grade and its findings change in place, with today's cache facts for those pages (no_validators, validators_ignored, stale_on_arrival clear at once). The insights' remeasured says what it fixed, what's still there and what's new. At most 4 a site a day; asking again while one waits is the same request. Caching's stale serving and uncached pages clear only once ordinary checks see them (each finding's `check`), and the browser's view, page weight and links wait for the daily run. It acts for the whole team. Needs a Member or Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
name: sites_by_slug_insights_recheck

requestedAt.description: when the re-measure was asked for; the monitor makes it within 30 seconds (ISO 8601, UTC)
